Create solution

Source: R/method_Solution.R
create_solution.Rd

Create a new_solution() object.

Usage

create_solution(
  name,
  project,
  column,
  legend,
  provenance,
  settings,
  tile = NULL,
  metrics = NULL,
  id = uuid::UUIDgenerate()
)

Arguments

name

character value with name.

project

new_project() object that has a column with the solution.

column

character value with column name in project$dataset that has the values.

legend

new_categorical_legend() or new_continuous_legend() object.

provenance

new_provenance() object.

settings

list of settings used to generate the solution.

tile

new_tile() object tile information for the solution. Defaults to NULL such that a new_tile() object is automatically created.

metrics

list with evaluation metrics for the solution. Defaults to NULL such that metrics are calculated automatically.

id

character value with unique identifier. Defaults to a random identifier (uuid::UUIDgenerate()).

Value

A Solution object.

See also

Other functions for calling class methods: create_dataset_from_sf(), create_legend(), create_solution_from_prioritization(), create_solution_legend(), create_tile_from_file(), create_tile_from_project(), create_tile_from_sf(), new_dataset(), tool_generated_provenance()

Examples

# simulate project
sim_project <- simulate_project()

# create solution
x <- create_solution(
  name = "user solution",
  project = sim_project,
  column = "solution",
  legend = simulate_solution_legend(),
  provenance = simulate_provenance(),
  settings = simulate_prioritization_settings(sim_project)
)

# print solution
print(x)
#> A <Solution> object.
#> • name: "user solution"
#> • id: "2802e58b-4aaf-4811-b195-1a2ccede195c"
#> • settings: <list> object
#> • metrics: <list> object
#> • layer: <Layer> object
